title: A bioelectric state can store the body plan regeneration rebuilds

statements.text: In planaria, a brief change to bioelectric networks, with no change to the genome, changes the body plan that later regeneration rebuilds: perturbed fragments regenerated two heads, kept that plan through later cuts, and returned to normal when the bioelectric state was reversed.
statements.scope: planarian regeneration, as reported in the basal-cognition repository

standing.reason: Proposed for integration in the seed proposal, pending the user's review.
